title: JANUS Engine — dedicated research-branch manifest
purpose: Provide a dedicated branch and structured index for all JANUS Engine records, simulations and literature crawls without breaking existing canonical data paths on main.

branching_policy.rule: Existing JANUS Engine records remain at their canonical data/ paths inherited from main; new branch-specific research/index artifacts are stored under projects/janus-engine/.
branching_policy.main_policy: No automatic merge to main. Research results mature on research/janus-engine first.

MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.description: O2-selective artificial gill feeds a low-pO2 recirculating gas loop and PEM fuel cell; moisture and heat are managed in a closed gas-side service loop. Bulk O2/N2 separation and LOX are not mandatory for first self-drive testing.

MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.description: Extract/condition dissolved-gas stream, separate O2/N2, cascade N2 through cooling/regeneration/inert duties, and add cryogenic functions only after positive gaseous-mode margins are measured.

current_project_state.dominant_boss: Real artificial-gill module transport: J_O2 versus water velocity and collector pO2, coupled to DeltaP and auxiliary sweep/vacuum power.

next_actions: Follow citation graph outward from the 2005 artificial-gill hollow-fiber study and 2025 artificial-gill PEMFC prototype.
Translate arXiv PSA digital-twin equations into a JANUS-compatible sorbent-cycle model.
Run a direct-gill PEMFC energy balance separately from the full VRU/AKS architecture.
Do not merge branch conclusions to main until model assumptions are explicitly tagged or replaced by measurements.
